_comment: Critical npm advisories (functions/, prod deps) temporarily accepted by tools/security/npm_audit_gate.py. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry (max ~1 month). An expired entry fails CI again. Remove the entry in the same PR that fixes the dependency.

GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h.reason: Only affects apps that configure Express 'trust proxy' with an IPv4 subnet; functions/src never sets 'trust proxy'. Fix: proxy-addr 2.0.8 is semver-compatible (`npm update proxy-addr` in functions/, lockfile-only).

GHSA-xv26-6w52-cph6.reason: Only reachable through the Realtime Database client, which talks to Google's servers; no user-controlled WebSocket peer. Fix: websocket-driver 0.7.5 is semver-compatible (`npm update websocket-driver` in functions/, lockfile-only).
